entities.name: General Varchild
entities.description: Leader of the Kjeldoran army in the last years of the Ice Age who later went rogue and led a private army against the Balduvians.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation on Dominaria whose army Varchild led.

entities.name: Balduvian barbarians
entities.description: Barbarians whom Varchild despised and later waged war on; they allied with Kjeldor against Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Ice Age and Flood Age take place.

entities.name: Avram Garrison
entities.description: De facto leader of Kjeldoran troops who formed the Knights of Stromgald; Varchild was his aide.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor, son of the queen; he took direct control of the military orders after the Stromgalds fell.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Organization formed by Garrison to kill the king and blame the Balduvians and wizards.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer revealed as secret benefactor of the Stromgalds, defeated in Lim-Dul's Battle.

entities.name: Lim-Dul's Battle
entities.description: Clash in which Kjeldor and the Balduvians defeated Lim-Dul forever.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Discovered Varchild when she assaulted Lovisa Coldeyes's camp.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Balduvian whose camp Varchild assaulted in 2954 AR.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation formed by Kjeldor and the Balduvians that rallied against Varchild.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: City where Varchild went to become a knight.

events.summary: Varchild endures a hard childhood in the Hinterlands, losing family to Balduvian raids and Lim-Dul's undead.
events.quote: Varchild had a hard life, losing a brother in a Balduvian raid

events.summary: Varchild rises to become aide to Avram Garrison.
events.quote: Varchild became a Captain in the Kjeldoran army and was appointed as Avram's aide.

events.summary: Garrison forms the Knights of Stromgald to kill the king; Varchild refuses and defends the king with her life.
events.quote: Varchild could not go along with murdering the king of the nation

events.summary: The Stromgalds are defeated and Lim-Dul is revealed as their benefactor; Varchild becomes first general of the unified army.
events.quote: Varchild was honored to become the first general of the nation's unified army in generations

events.summary: Varchild fights alongside the Balduvians in Lim-Dul's Battle, which defeats Lim-Dul forever.
events.quote: she set aside her personal feelings and fought alongside the barbarian forces

events.summary: Varchild is presumed killed with her troop in a battle against orcs and ogres in 2949 AR but survives and uses it to her advantage.
events.quote: However, Varchild survived the skirmish, and she used her presumed death to her advantage.

events.summary: Varchild builds a war band of followers and wages war on the Balduvians.
events.quote: She started recruiting followers from the low folk

events.summary: Jodah discovers Varchild when she assaults Lovisa Coldeyes's camp in 2954 AR; she is marked a traitor.
events.quote: Varchild was suddenly marked as a traitor to Kjeldor

events.summary: New Argive forms and rallies against Varchild, stealing her troops and ending her crusade.
events.quote: Varchild's crusade petered out as the nation of New Argive formed and rallied against her

relations.quote: General Varchild was the leader of the Kjeldoran army
becoming the right hand of Avram Garrison

relations.note: despised them and later led a private army against them
relations.quote: led a private army against the Balduvian barbarians
drove Garrison to form the Knights of Stromgald
Lim-Dûl was revealed as the secret benefactor behind the group
